title: Applet: make it clear which mode is currently selected
line: The Display Configuration widget now highlights the screen layout button that matches how your screens are currently set up.
explanation: The widget's five screen layout buttons are one-shot actions: after applying one, nothing showed which layout was in effect, so users could not tell whether their screens were mirrored, extended or switched off. The change adds OsdAction::currentAction(), the counterpart of applyAction(): with two connected screens it reports which preset the current configuration matches (only one screen enabled, mirrored, or the external screen right next to the built-in one on either side). The applet exposes it and marks the matching button as checked; any other arrangement leaves all buttons unmarked, and it updates live when the configuration changes.

commits.message:
plasmoid: highlight the screen layout that matches the current setup

The applet's layout buttons never showed which one was in use, so users
could not tell whether their screens were mirrored or extended. Check the
current configuration against each preset and mark the matching button.

BUG: 469366
